subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh one of the open conflict-marked fork candidates or sponsor a fresh target-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but target-repository fix attempts are closed unmerged and the live fork PRs are conflict-marked, while the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr and needs maintainer review.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR that fixes Feishu post URL rendering with tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs as implementation context.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Choose the better open fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new automated branch until a contributor refreshes a candidate with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Create or promote one narrow OpenClaw PR that fixes Feishu post URL rendering with tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs as implementation context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the implementation path.
